displayName: RegWatch scheduler trigger failed (job never started)

documentation.content: A Cloud Scheduler trigger could not launch its Cloud Run job, so NO execution exists. The two execution-count policies cannot see this: they alert on jobs that ran and failed. PERMISSION_DENIED here means the scheduler service account is missing roles/run.invoker on the target job -- see deploy/provision.sh, the invoker loop. This is how the weekly regwatch-prune trigger failed silently from 2026-08-20 to 2026-08-26.

conditions.displayName: Cloud Scheduler attempt finished with a non-OK status
